/archive-converter.supportedFormatsDesc: ZIP to TAR or 7Z; TAR and TAR.GZ (TGZ) to ZIP. 7Z and RAR are not supported as inputs.

howItWorksSteps.title: Upload the archive
howItWorksSteps.desc: Select a ZIP, TAR, TAR.GZ, or TGZ file. ZIP is the only input that can produce 7Z output.

howItWorksSteps.title: Choose the output format
howItWorksSteps.desc: Pick ZIP, TAR or 7Z as the target format.

howItWorksSteps.title: Convert the archive
howItWorksSteps.desc: One ForAll safely unpacks and repacks the archive.

howItWorksSteps.title: Download the new archive
howItWorksSteps.desc: Save the converted archive to your computer.

features.title: Safe extraction
features.desc: Archive entries are checked for path traversal and entry-count/size limits before anything is unpacked.

features.title: Common formats covered
features.desc: Convert ZIP to TAR or 7Z, and TAR or TAR.GZ to ZIP.

features.title: Temporary file handling
features.desc: Source and result archives are cleaned up under the platform storage policy.

faqList.q: Can I convert RAR or 7Z to ZIP?
faqList.a: No. The current tool accepts ZIP, TAR, and TAR.GZ inputs. It can create 7Z output from ZIP.

faqList.q: Are very large archives supported?
faqList.a: Processing is limited to 2,000 file entries and 512 MiB of uncompressed file data. Archives above those limits are rejected.

faqList.q: Are archive filenames and folders preserved?
faqList.a: File paths are used when files are repacked. Empty directories and archive metadata may not be preserved.
